name: A Man on the Inside
description: A retired professor with a knack for snooping gets a new lease on life when a private investigator recruits him to go undercover and crack a case.

videos.title: Tinker Tailor Older Spy
videos.overview: Encouraged by his daughter to try something new, widower Charles Nieuwendyk answers an ad from a private eye seeking a mole at a retirement community.

videos.title: The Man Who Knew Too Much About Bridges
videos.overview: Charles charms his fellow residents at happy hour while finding his footing as a sleuth. But will a mysterious warning end the case before it even begins?

videos.title: The Emily Always Rings Twice
videos.overview: Charles has some explaining to do when Emily unexpectedly arrives in town — and another missing item lands him in Elliott's cranky crosshairs.

videos.title: The Curious Incident of the Dog in the Painting Class
videos.overview: Pacific View's group activities give Charles the perfect opportunity to narrow down his list of suspects, but his chumminess raises concerns for Julie.

videos.title: Presents and Clear Danger
videos.overview: While Julie uses a lavish gift as bait, Charles tries to connect with Gladys. Virginia encourages Florence to splurge on something she's always wanted.

videos.title: Our Man in Sacramento
videos.overview: As the Pacific View community reels from a sudden loss, Charles goes on an emotional journey with Emily. Didi weighs an intriguing offer from corporate.

videos.title: From Russian Hill with Love
videos.overview: On a tour of San Francisco's historic sites, Charles and Calbert bond while talking about the past, present and future. Didi and Julie lock horns.

videos.title: The Spy Who Came In from the Cold
videos.overview: When the pieces click into place, Charles faces the difficult task of revealing his true purpose at Pacific View. Emily helps him unpack the past.

videos.title: Orientation
videos.overview: When a college president's secrets fall into the wrong hands, Charles poses as a visiting lecturer on campus to sniff out an anonymous blackmailer.

videos.title: Major Declaration
videos.overview: While Julie enlists an unlikely expert to dig into new evidence, Charles finds himself on thin ice when his professional and personal lives intersect.

videos.title: Family Weekend
videos.overview: A briefing with Brad turns into a chaotic brainstorming session. Emily gets called in as backup when her dad has lingering doubts about Mona.

videos.title: Spirit Week
videos.overview: The blackmailer's pressure escalates, a new suspect emerges and a cherished school tradition forces Charles to navigate a glittering gauntlet.

videos.title: Thanksgiving Break
videos.overview: The Nieuwendyks' Thanksgiving dinner comes with a side of commotion as an overstuffed table and a pie-related crisis test everyone's holiday spirit.

videos.title: Extracurriculars
videos.overview: Out of leads, Charles and Julie wonder if they've been searching in the wrong direction all along. Work takes a backseat when Mona and Emily play hooky.

videos.title: Group Project
videos.overview: Charles turns a class reunion into a high-stakes heist, complete with code names, sleight-of-hand and a crew of operatives with more heart than skill.

videos.title: Final Exams
videos.overview: As the final puzzle pieces of the Wheeler case fall into place, new doors open for everyone — detectives and suspects alike.
